name: AuraMed
tagline: Women's-health screening platform with a doctor sign-off workflow
problem: Early screening for breast cancer, cervical cytology and PCOS, with a clinician in the loop instead of a bare prediction screen.
built: Three PyTorch image models (ResNet-50 and ViT-B/16) with Grad-CAM heatmaps: 95% accuracy on PCOS (3,800+ ultrasound images) and 93.13% on cervical cytology.
Image output fused with clinical scoring (Gail model, Rotterdam criteria) into an explained risk score.
Admin, doctor and patient portals with a sign, lock, addendum and release report workflow.

name: Hash Patch
tagline: Offline post-quantum crypto scanner and CBOM generator
problem: Organisations cannot tell which of their cryptography is actually used, or what to migrate to post-quantum algorithms first.
built: Tree-sitter parsing of Java, Python, Go and C, with call-graph reachability to separate crypto that runs from dead or test code.
Signed CycloneDX 1.6 Crypto Bill of Materials plus a migration plan to ML-KEM and ML-DSA, prioritised with Mosca's theorem.
Packaged as an air-gapped Electron desktop app for Windows.

name: FSOC-PAT
tagline: AI beacon tracking simulator for optical communication terminals
problem: Free-space optical terminals must be coarsely aligned on a moving beacon before a laser link can lock.
built: Simulator that detects a moving beacon with classical CV, a PyTorch CNN, or a hybrid of both, tracked by Kalman/IMM filters and a PID camera servo.
All three modes benchmarked on identical trajectories and seeded disturbances, with CSV and PDF reports and measured pass/fail requirement checks.
Packaged as a Windows desktop app.

name: OptiFlow
tagline: Dynamic route optimization for deadline-bound truck fleets
problem: A depot fleet must serve hubs inside delivery deadlines, and re-plan when traffic, rain or road blocks change the picture.
built: Real-time fleet routing using geographic clustering, deadline-first insertion and 2-opt ordering, enforcing hub deadlines, a 7.5-hour driving limit and fuel capacity on real road networks.
Simulated traffic, rain and road-block events that trigger explained re-routing decisions.
Separate dispatcher and driver views. The logic is rule-based; there is no trained ML model.
result: Winner, Transportation & Logistics theme, CMR Hackfest 3.0

name: PulseEcho
tagline: Metro-to-bus transfer analysis from tap timing alone
problem: CUMTA problem statement 3, "Discover the Hidden Connections": where do Chennai Metro passengers switch to buses?
built: Treats train arrivals as pulses and buses at nearby stops as echoes; the excess boardings give the transfer volume without any linked ticket data.
Estimates the share to each stop and route, typical waits, and suggestions such as retiming or enlarging buses or adding feeder routes.

name: Neighborly
tagline: Hyperlocal services marketplace with escrow and a trust score
problem: Residents describe a need in plain words and get matched to nearby neighbours who can help.
built: Free-text request parser and a 0-100 match score on six weighted factors, shown as "Why this match?".
Booking state machine with wallet escrow and a 5% fee; live chat with masked contact details.

name: CryptIQ
tagline: Scan, repair and verify security demo for a small business
problem: Show a small shop the attack succeeding, apply the fix, then re-run the same attack to prove it now fails.
built: Python AST scan for eight risk families, a bounded dictionary attack and a tiny-RSA factoring demo.
Four dependent fixes applied as one atomic migration (passwords move to Argon2id), then four checks gate PDF and CycloneDX exports.

name: Reclaim
tagline: Cyber-fraud report preparation in English and Tamil
problem: Cyber-fraud victims struggle to prepare reporting documents and track report references.
built: Evidence intake with optional AI reading of screenshots, conflict and duplicate detection, reminders, and PDF and JSON export.

name: DairyFlow + Allocra
tagline: Chennai milk dispatch planner and control tower
problem: Plan and simulate early-morning milk deliveries from one plant to 8 hubs with 6 trucks.
built: Planner covering every hub with the fewest trucks then fewest kilometres, using real OSRM road routes.
Control tower that scores redirecting a truck against dispatching a reserve truck, with manager approval. Rule-based, not ML.
Allocra v2 adds JWT logins, booths and a product catalogue (in progress).

name: SatQuery AI
tagline: Natural-language Q&A over satellite images
problem: Ask plain-language questions about one or two GeoTIFF/PNG satellite images.
built: Trust Gate that validates input and routes it, with answers returned as an overlay, coordinates, confidence and execution trace.
Geospatial handling (GeoTIFF, coordinate transforms, ground sample distance) is real; the vision model is still a stub.

name: SylvaSense
tagline: Forest-monitoring UI prototype
problem: Forest monitoring with satellite data fusion, tree counting, carbon estimates and deforestation alerts.
built: Round-1 Next.js front end running on mock data, with a blueprint document and a recorded demo.

name: Resume Ranker AI
tagline: Six-stage pipeline ranking 100k candidates
problem: Pick the top 100 candidates for a Senior AI Engineer role from up to 100,000 profiles.
built: BM25 retrieval, MiniLM embeddings, trust-weighted skill overlap, career-fit scoring, trap detection and MMR diversity re-ranking.
A generated reason for each pick and a validated submission.csv.

name: Aadhaar Pressure Update Intelligence
tagline: Where Aadhaar update demand builds up
problem: Analyse the UIDAI dataset to find where Aadhaar update demand builds up.
built: Python data-cleaning and analysis notebooks with generated outputs and a data app.

name: UFDR Analyzer
tagline: Digital-forensics tool for phone extraction reports
problem: Investigators need to explore contacts, calls and messages inside UFDR extraction files.
built: Python web app that loads contacts, calls and messages, with mock-data generators and a communication-network view.

name: MemoryAgent
tagline: Assistant with long-term memory that ages and corrects itself
problem: Assistants forget durable facts about a user between sessions.
built: Facts stored with a confidence score; recall ranks by relevance, confidence and recency.
Confidence decays over time, stale memories are deleted and close duplicates overwrite old facts.
event: Global AI Hackathon with Qwen Cloud (Track 1)

name: Capstone: Enterprise Knowledge Platform
tagline: Privacy-first RAG platform for company knowledge
problem: Staff need to search company knowledge while keeping access private and auditable.
built: FastAPI backend with authentication, retrieval, conflict detection between sources, an audit log and integrations.
React + TypeScript front end with a unified intelligence page.

name: Sondra
tagline: Private music streaming from your own Google Drive
problem: Play your own audio library without copying files to a server.
built: FastAPI backend streams from Google Drive over a read-only OAuth connection, with a React admin dashboard and a Flutter player for Android and Windows.

name: Notally
tagline: Offline encrypted notebook app in Flutter
problem: A secure offline notebook.
built: Flutter app organised into core and feature modules, with an Android build.

name: BookMyShow Deluxe
tagline: Java Swing movie ticket booking app
problem: Desktop ticket booking with user and admin panels.
built: Swing screens for login, showtimes, a colour-coded seat map and simulated payment; admin panel for movies, showtimes and bookings.
All data goes through one DatabaseManager to SQLite over JDBC.

name: Hospital Management System (MAD 1)
tagline: IIT Madras hospital app with admin, doctor and patient roles
problem: Appointment booking and medical history across three roles.
built: Server-rendered Flask app with Jinja templates and SQLite, appointment booking, patient history and admin blacklisting.

name: Hospital Management System (MAD 2)
tagline: Flask API, Vue front end and background jobs
problem: The MAD 1 hospital app rebuilt as an API with a single-page front end and scheduled jobs.
built: Flask REST backend with a Vue frontend; Celery worker and beat run emails and exports, with Redis as broker and cache.

name: Portfolio
tagline: This site: a data-driven personal portfolio
problem: One place where every claim links to proof.
built: Content lives in JSON data files and proof folders; new wins and certificates need no code change.
